title: "EDA"
format: html

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
data <- readRDS(here::here("data-files", "data"))

```

```{r}
new_data <- data |>
  summarize(
  rows = n(),
  variables = n_distinct(variable),
  tracts = n_distinct(short_name),
  neighborhoods = n_distinct(neighborhood),
  wards = n_distinct(ward))

var_counts <- data |>
  count(variable)

```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)

var_counts <- data |>
  count(variable) |>
  mutate(
    label = variable |>
      str_remove("^Estimate!!") |>          
      str_replace_all("!!|_|\\.", " ") |>   
      str_squish() |>
      str_to_sentence() |>
      str_trunc(45)                      
  )

ggplot(var_counts, aes(x = n, y = fct_reorder(label, n))) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = n, yend = label),
               color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 1.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_comma(),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(x = "Number of observations (tracts)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "grey20"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

  
key_variables_df <- subset(data, variable %in% c("Poverty Rate (%)", "Percent Foreign-Born", "Percent Positive Land Uses", "Transit Stops Per Capita", "Percent Tract Within 15-Minute Walk of Health Care Facility", "% of Students Chronically Absent, 24-25")) 


```

```{r}
missing <- key_variables_df |>
  group_by(variable) |>
  summarize(
    n_missing = sum(is.na(estimate)),
    pct_missing = mean(is.na(estimate)) * 100
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(pct_missing))

summary_stats <- key_variables_df |>
  group_by(variable) |>
  summarize(
    mean = mean(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = min(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(estimate, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

tracts_neighborhoods <- data |>
  distinct(short_name, neighborhood) |>
  count(neighborhood, sort = TRUE)

```
  
```{r}
ggplot(tracts_neighborhoods, aes(x = neighborhood, y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "lightblue") +
   scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma(),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(x = "Neighborhood", y = "Number of Tracts") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank() 
  )
```
  
  
```{r}
ggplot(key_variables_df, aes(factor(ward), estimate)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.6, outlier.size = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Ward", y = "Estimate") +
  theme_minimal() 
```



# A correlation heatmap summarizes all pairs at once and is compact:
```{r}
library(sf)

dupes <- key_variables_df |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  count(short_name) |>
  filter(n > 1)

dupes

key_variables_df |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  semi_join(head(dupes, 3), by = c("short_name")) |>
  arrange(short_name)

cors <- key_variables_df |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(short_name, variable, estimate) |>
  distinct() |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = estimate) |>
  select(-short_name) |>
  cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs") |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("v1") |>
  pivot_longer(-v1, names_to = "v2", values_to = "r")

ggplot(cors, aes(v1, v2, fill = r)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(r, 2)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "firebrick", mid = "white", high = "steelblue",
                       limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "r") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
